title: Sunday · the top of the steps
logline: The wooden steps down to the beach from the bluff, March, and at the top, the dog, fourteen, looking down them. Wood's shadow. The strip watches him not go down.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the long wooden stair down the bluff to the beach, weathered, the beach and the sea below. At the top, on the landing: an old dog, sitting, looking down.

characters.pose: at the top, sitting, looking down

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a long weathered wooden stairway descending a bluff to a beach with an old dog sitting at the top landing looking down it, no words

panels.name: Steps

panels.composition: Tier 2: the dog, close, and beside him a man's shadow on the boards, waiting.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, an old dog sitting on weathered boards beside a man's long shadow, no words

panels.name: Shadow

panels.composition: Tier 3: the beach from the top of the stairs, empty, the sea, the light. Where they aren't. Held.

panels.name: Beach

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Seven months before The Steep Path. He doesn't go down. The strip doesn't say.
